summary: Used null sentinel from listLocalBranches() to distinguish 'enumeration failed' from 'legitimately empty branch set'
context: PR A review fixes: replaced knownBranchesEmpty heuristic with explicit null sentinel; added archived to ValueStats lifecycle; regression test for blackboard-only branch_gone audit.
rationale: the prior knownBranchesEmpty heuristic produced false negatives whenever decisions[] was empty, silently dropping the branch_gone signal for blackboard-only audits.
